name: emlang-grammar-refactoring
details: Refactor compositional.fgr to reduce repetitive patterns by 67% using treebender's rewrite rules and meta-patterns. Transform verbose enumeration into elegant abstractions while preserving all functionality.

tasks.name: Setup and Validation
tasks.details: Prepare environment for safe refactoring with comprehensive testing

sub_tasks.name: Set up test harness
sub_tasks.details: Create testing script to compare outputs between original and refactored grammars

sub_tasks.name: Baseline test run
sub_tasks.details: Run all existing tests on original grammar to establish baseline

tasks.name: Simple Patterns Refactoring
tasks.details: Start with the simplest consolidations to build confidence

sub_tasks.name: Contents pattern
sub_tasks.details: Consolidate Contents recursion pattern (12→8 lines) using ContentItem abstraction

sub_tasks.name: CompTarget pattern
sub_tasks.details: Consolidate CompTarget enumeration (14→10 lines) using TargetStructure abstraction

sub_tasks.name: FusedContents pattern
sub_tasks.details: Consolidate FusedContents operators (14→8 lines) using Fuseable abstraction

sub_tasks.name: Test simple patterns
sub_tasks.details: Verify all simple pattern refactorings work correctly

tasks.name: High-Impact Patterns Refactoring
tasks.details: Tackle the patterns with biggest reduction potential

sub_tasks.name: AnnotatedStructures pattern
sub_tasks.details: Create CommonMarker and ElementMarker abstractions (66→13 lines, 80% reduction)

sub_tasks.name: PatternContent pattern
sub_tasks.details: Create Matchable abstraction for pattern contents (74→14 lines, 81% reduction)

sub_tasks.name: Test high-impact patterns
sub_tasks.details: Thoroughly test AnnotatedStructures and PatternContent refactorings

tasks.name: Feature-Based Patterns Refactoring
tasks.details: Refactor patterns that use feature tag unification

sub_tasks.name: Pattern can-match
sub_tasks.details: Use feature propagation instead of explicit enumeration (19→12 lines)

sub_tasks.name: Verify feature propagation
sub_tasks.details: Ensure feature tags properly unify through new abstractions

tasks.name: Verification and Finalization
tasks.details: Complete testing and replace original with refactored version

sub_tasks.name: Full test suite
sub_tasks.details: Run complete test suite on refactored grammar

sub_tasks.name: Parse tree comparison
sub_tasks.details: Verify identical parse trees between original and refactored

sub_tasks.name: Edge case testing
sub_tasks.details: Manually test complex edge cases and feature interactions

sub_tasks.name: Replace original
sub_tasks.details: Backup original and replace with refactored version

sub_tasks.name: Update documentation
sub_tasks.details: Document the refactoring patterns and new abstractions
